must: Interpolate the environment continuously from local time and live sunrise/sunset when enabled.
Treat weather as atmosphere, never as a content-blocking interaction.
Preserve readable semantic surfaces and WCAG AA contrast across every sky state.
Honor reduced motion, lower visual quality, visibility state, and mobile safe areas.
avoid: Full-screen photographic wallpaper behind application content.
Repeated star tiles, looping rain stripes, frequent shooting stars, and periodic lightning.
Hard scene cuts, layout-shifting animation, and decorative motion inside focus or reading modes.

decisions: Keep the persisted UI key living-sky for backwards compatibility while labeling the experience Living Nature.
Use procedural CSS and canvas layers with normalized time, weather, sun, and moon values.
Use the existing custom Radix-style primitives instead of adding a parallel component library.
Use Segoe UI Variable Text and a 16px body floor for legibility without adding a remote font dependency.
